about: Reference run times (seconds) of the golden files in grbl-sim (gnea/grbl 1.1h + grbl/grbl-sim, built in WSL Ubuntu 24.04), streamed line by line (send, wait for ok). Machine: $110-$112=5000, $120=500, $121=500, $122=200, $11=0.010, $12=0.002; start at X0 Y0 Z0. Time = first step to last step, includes dwells. Measured 2026-10-15. Re-measure if a golden file changes.
